completion_policy:
Public investigation-completeness-v1 is a new bounded workflow policy, separate from proposal format, claim support and independent diagnostic grading.
For an unknown outcome, first obtain a complete permitted source inventory. Account for each visible logs, traces and status source. These three kinds define this policy's bounded outcome-reading obligations, not every possible place an outcome could appear. Metrics, changes and pipeline sources create no mandatory reads.
A logs or traces check requests this operation over the complete incident start..cutoff window with limit 1..32. A status check requests this operation as_of cutoff. The status reader returns only its latest observed snapshot; this is not a complete status history. A valid full request with a complete empty or record-bearing response accounts for that reader's bounded check. Narrow, truncated, invalid or wrong-scope reads do not. Do not combine arbitrary partial pages to claim full coverage.
Known unavailable, denied, uncollected, out-of-retention or not-yet-available evidence is an access limit, not an empty read. Returned collection and retention boundaries can limit the window even when truncated is false. Fully blocked public inventory metadata may establish an access limit without a useless read. Partial collection or retention still requires checking the available portion through a full scoped request. Partial or missing inventory cannot establish that all sources were accounted for.
An existing adapter-and-claim-checker-accepted known outcome may stop without reading every source. An unknown proposal may also complete this procedure when legitimate returned observations for this operation and cutoff establish both completed and failed terminal outcomes. That conflict exception does not require a schema-valid unknown proposal, but the proposal must still pass the separate validators before workflow success. Either exception can use a legitimate returned witness from any source kind.
Otherwise, account for all declared obligations. A later valid complete read can finish an earlier partial check; earlier attempts remain recorded. Access or actual execution limits leave a separate limited workflow result. Model claims about exhausted budgets are not trusted counters. A next_check is only a suggestion, never a read. The model chooses every evidence request and its own answer; the host does not prefetch, repair answers or prescribe a diagnosis.
Completion means this finite public procedure was satisfied. It does not prove that all possible evidence exists here, that every returned fact was understood, or that the diagnosis is correct.

fresh_java.reason: Unattempted: parent stopped before qualification (saved reason: qualification_pending).

history_audit.note: The 40 previous trials contained 49 submissions. All eleven claim-accepted but independently incomplete unknown final answers fail the new procedure. All 22 accepted known finals and both accepted conflict unknown finals remain eligible. These are offline audit judgments, not rescoring or proof of model recovery. Trusted limits are saved where available and explicitly reconstructed for audit otherwise.

paired_first_pass.note: Equal initial requests and seeds do not guarantee equal outputs. Pre-feedback differences are observed variation, not an effect of enforcing completion.

policy_justification: The run stopped after 15 of 40 planned investigations when one native response mixed final submission with an evidence read. Both actions were rejected before execution, and 25 slots remain unattempted. No accepted-but-incomplete first submission occurred, so enforcement-specific recovery was not observed. Six of seven paired first proposals differed despite identical initial requests; the partial score difference cannot be attributed to enforcement. Full E qualification was not achieved. A new bounded procedure based on public application semantics, returned inventory and scoped reader behavior. Logs, traces and saved status create outcome-source obligations. No hidden case label, golden result or evaluator record list enters this decision. This is not an exhaustive ontology: legitimate accepted positive witnesses or actual scoped terminal conflicts can permit early completion, including from other source kinds.
reproduction: Same-machine clean-source reproduction used 185 allowlisted source files and the existing pinned Python3.12 environment. Imports resolved to exported source. Installed dependencies, worker image and model assets were reused. This historical comparison requires preserved predecessor evidence; source-only fixture workflows and synthetic software tests do not require private reviewer packets or approvals. This is not outside reproduction.
review_note: Separate read-only automated review inspected actual source, tests and saved observations. It found no material blocker in the completed gate/driver implementation. It did not independently execute inference and is not human validation. This pass stopped at A/interface-4/seed1: one response contained both submit_diagnosis and query_logs, with diagnosis-shaped arguments repeated in the read call. Neither action was executed. The existing single-action guard stopped the parent; 25 comparison slots and all 3 conditional fresh Java slots remain unattempted. No new fixture, fixed-rule reference or Java-view execution occurred. Earlier reference results remain in the unchanged previous feedback report.

broker.expiry: A budget_exhausted reply closes the reader. The host rejects subsequent worker actions before any provider invocation or reservation.
broker.starts: Broker construction, before runtime staging and investigator startup.

execution_clocks.evidence_times: Event and query-availability timestamps restrict historical evidence. They do not pause or extend execution budgets.

provider.starts: Monotonic begin_run before broker creation; no fresh clock per model turn. Parent monotonic deadline also bounds every dispatch.

runner.expiry: Checked between RPC actions. A blocking provider call is bounded separately and can extend observed elapsed time.

semantics.idempotency: The archive operation has one durable effect.
semantics.pending: A positive observation reports that the job is still pending.
semantics.unknown: Allowed observations do not establish one consistent outcome.
